old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a ceiling light fixture against a dark background. The light fixture features a white lampshade with a visible bulb at its center. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the lampshade and bulb. The light fixture starts to spin rapidly, causing the lampshade to rotate and the light to flicker intermittently. The spinning motion creates a dynamic visual effect, with the light fixture appearing to move in a circular path. The dark background contrasts sharply with the bright light from the bulb, emphasizing the spinning motion and the flickering effect. The video concludes with the light fixture still spinning, maintaining the same rapid rotation and flickering light.

caption: A low-angle close-up frames an illuminated ceiling lamp against a featureless black background. The white, glossy dome shade appears as an oval, with a dark socket ring at its center and a warm-white bulb glowing below it. A faint diagonal shadow streak and a small bright reflection near the shade's upper edge persist throughout. Within the frame the shade drifts and tilts, sliding from a centered position toward the left, then settling right-of-center and higher, while the oval's elongation changes with the shifting viewing angle. Motion blur rises and falls intermittently, strongest during the middle of the excerpt, marking continuous relative movement that is already underway at both ends. The bulb stays lit and attached to the socket, its offset from the ring varying as the angle changes. No part separates or disappears against the uniform darkness.
